tables.name: categories

constraints.name: categories_parent_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_categories_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON categories FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

constraints.name: event_categories_category_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: event_categories_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: events
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_events_date_years_bp ON public.events USING btree (date_years_bp DESC NULLS LAST)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_events_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

constraints.name: period_categories_category_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: period_categories_period_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (period_id) REFERENCES periods(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: periods

constraints.name: periods_parent_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES periods(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_periods_end_years_bp ON public.periods USING btree (end_years_bp)
CREATE INDEX idx_periods_parent_id ON public.periods USING btree (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_periods_start_years_bp ON public.periods USING btree (start_years_bp DESC NULLS LAST)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_periods_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON periods FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: stories

constraints.name: stories_owner_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: stories_parent_same_owner
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (parent_story_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES stories(id, owner_user_id)

indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_stories_is_public ON public.stories USING btree (is_public)
CREATE INDEX idx_stories_parent_story_id ON public.stories USING btree (parent_story_id)
CREATE INDEX stories_owner_user_id_idx ON public.stories USING btree (owner_user_id)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_stories_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON stories FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
